circle.title: Online Wardley Maps (damonsk) (source: landscape) Free browser tool drawing Wardley maps from a text DSL with an interactive editor and submaps; text-first with a visual layer; the hosted page showed only Loading to the fetch. Kind: text-first + visual. Openness: open (MIT). Status: active-looking: no dates read. https://github.com/damonsk/onlinewardleymaps (read 2026-11-22)

Mermaid Wardley diagram (source: landscape) Text-based Wardley diagram type (keyword wardley-beta) with components, anchors, links, evolve arrows, pipelines, notes, sourcing decorators and accelerators. Kind: text-first. Openness: open (MIT). Status: beta. https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/wardley.html (read 2026-11-22)

Wardley Maps for VS Code (source: landscape) Extension to render and edit maps in VS Code using the Online Wardley Maps engine; text-first, reads .wm and .owm. Kind: text-first plugin. Openness: open (MIT, text not seen). Status: no dates read. https://github.com/damonsk/vscode-wardley-maps (read 2026-11-22)

Wardley Maps for Obsidian (source: landscape) Obsidian community plugin rendering and editing maps in the Online Wardley Maps format inside a code block; text-first. Kind: text-first plugin. Openness: open (AGPL-3.0). Status: last push Nov 2024 per an aggregator snippet. https://github.com/damonsk/obsidian-wardley-maps (read 2026-11-22)

Go-Wardley (source: landscape) Go program generating a Wardley map as SVG from an HCL text description, with hover details and a local web server; text-first. Kind: text-first CLI. Openness: open (MPL-2.0). Status: no dates read. https://github.com/DavidGamba/go-wardley (read 2026-11-22)

wardleyToGo (source: landscape) Go library and toolset defining maps as code or data and rendering SVG; supports the onlinewardleymap syntax and its own WTG2 language; browser playground. Kind: text-first library. Openness: open (MIT). Status: no dates read. https://github.com/owulveryck/wardleyToGo (read 2026-11-22)

cli-owm (source: landscape) Command-line renderer turning Online Wardley Maps DSL into SVG, with five themes. Kind: text-first CLI. Openness: open (MIT). Status: no dates read. https://github.com/monkeypants/cli-owm (read 2026-11-22)

ipywardley (source: landscape) Jupyter extension adding a %%wardley cell magic drawing maps from a subset of the Online Wardley Maps syntax. Kind: text-first notebook. Openness: open (GPL-3.0). Status: no dates read. https://github.com/anjackson/ipywardley (read 2026-11-22)

Map (macOS, Linux, wmap CLI) (source: landscape) Community list names a native macOS app, a GTK4 Linux app and a wmap CLI using a text syntax called wmap; the CLI renders PNG or SVG. Kind: text-first apps. Openness: open (GPLv3 / AGPLv3, per a list). Status: own site 403. https://list.wardleymaps.com/ (read 2026-11-22)

MapScript (source: landscape) Map-as-code tool built on Observable notebooks with a hosted version at mapscript.org. Kind: text-first, hosted. Openness: not read. Status: listed Discontinued, reason not stated. https://list.wardleymaps.com/ (read 2026-11-22)

Mapkeep (source: landscape) Described as a multiplayer Wardley map editor with free map hosting. Kind: drag-and-drop, collaborative, hosted. Openness: not read. Status: listed Discontinued, reason not stated. https://list.wardleymaps.com/ (read 2026-11-22)

MapAware (source: landscape) Browser-based collaborative Wardley mapping with keyboard-first controls and real-time editing, labelled beta; account required; price and licence not stated. Kind: drag-and-drop, collaborative, hosted. Openness: closed? not stated. Status: beta; status unverified. https://learnwardleymapping.com/portfolio/mapaware/ (read 2026-11-22)

SharpCloud (Wardley use) (source: landscape) Commercial visualisation platform that offered a route to Wardley maps. Kind: commercial platform. Openness: closed? not stated. Status: listed Discontinued for Wardley use, reason not stated. https://learnwardleymapping.com/portfolio/sharpcloud/ (read 2026-11-22)

Miro Wardley template (source: landscape) General online whiteboard with a Wardley Map template; drag-and-drop; no price or licence read. Kind: whiteboard template. Openness: closed? not stated. Status: no dates read. https://learnwardleymapping.com/portfolio/miro/ (read 2026-11-22)

Excalidraw with Wardley library (source: landscape) Free whiteboard needing no account with community Wardley symbol libraries; drag-and-drop. Kind: whiteboard + symbol library. Openness: open (MIT). Status: no dates read. https://learnwardleymapping.com/portfolio/excalidraw/ (read 2026-11-22)

Glamorous Toolkit (source: landscape) Moldable development environment; the community list says it combines maps with notebooks; its own product page does not mention Wardley maps. Kind: development environment. Openness: open (MIT). Status: Wardley not on its own page. https://gtoolkit.com (read 2026-11-22)

Create Maps (wardleymaps.ai) (source: landscape) AI-assisted Wardley map creation tool listed on wardleymaps.ai; only the listing page was read, not the tool; price, licence and formats not stated. Kind: AI-assisted. Openness: not stated. Status: only the listing read. https://www.wardleymaps.ai (read 2026-11-22)

Dated history played over time, and a source on every node: no page read mentions either (to verify) (source: cartographer) landscape.d finding wt-g4: possible gap, to verify before any claim; its gaps wt-g5: most commit dates are not visible, three sites were unreachable, the AI map creator was read as a listing only. Not a claim that nobody does this

svg.text: Green: user need. Purple: the shared goal. Blue: component. Red ring: a gap (named as missing in the sources). Orange arrow: a suggested move, for strategy.d. Faint dashed: low confidence. Positions are a reading of the sources.
